title: The Death of Saul

questions.question: Who fought against Israel causing them to flee?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:1 (ESV): "Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled..."

questions.question: Which sons of Saul were killed?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:2 (ESV): "And the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul."

questions.question: How was Saul wounded?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:3 (ESV): "...and the archers found him, and he was wounded by the archers."

questions.question: What did Saul ask his armor-bearer to do?
options: Draw his sword and thrust him through
questions.correctAnswer: Draw his sword and thrust him through
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:4 (ESV): "Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, 'Draw your sword and thrust me through with it...'"

questions.question: How did Saul die?
options: He took his own sword and fell upon it
questions.correctAnswer: He took his own sword and fell upon it
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:4 (ESV): "...So Saul took his own sword and fell upon it."

questions.question: What did the armor-bearer do when he saw Saul was dead?
options: He also fell upon his sword and died
questions.correctAnswer: He also fell upon his sword and died
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:5 (ESV): "And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do with Saul’s head?
options: Fastened it in the temple of Dagon
questions.correctAnswer: Fastened it in the temple of Dagon
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:10 (ESV): "And they put his armor in the temple of their gods and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon."

questions.question: Who buried the bones of Saul and his sons?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:11-12 (ESV): "When all Jabesh-gilead heard... all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul..."

questions.question: Where were Saul’s bones buried?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:12 (ESV): "...and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh..."

questions.question: Why did Saul die according to the chronicler?
options: Because of his breach of faith against the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Because of his breach of faith against the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:13 (ESV): "So Saul died for his breach of faith. He broke faith with the LORD..."

questions.question: Who did Saul consult instead of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:13 (ESV): "...and also consulted a medium, seeking guidance."

questions.question: What happened to the kingdom after Saul’s death?
options: The Lord turned it over to David the son of Jesse
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord turned it over to David the son of Jesse
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:14 (ESV): "...Therefore the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse."

questions.question: How long did the men of Jabesh-gilead fast?
Did Saul keep the command of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:13 (ESV): "...for he did not keep the command of the LORD..."

questions.question: Where did the Philistines put Saul's armor?
options: In the temple of their gods
questions.correctAnswer: In the temple of their gods
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 10:10 (ESV): "And they put his armor in the temple of their gods..."

key_verse_text: So Saul died for his breach of faith. He broke faith with the LORD in that he did not keep the command of the LORD, and also consulted a medium, seeking guidance. He did not seek guidance from the LORD. Therefore the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
